# `aube access grant`

- **Usage:** `aube access grant <ARGS>…`
- **Effect:** modifies state

Grant a team read-only or read-write access to a package.

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/publishing) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->

## Arguments

- **`<PERMISSIONS>`** — `read-only` or `read-write`.
- **`<TEAM>`** — Team in `@scope:team` form.
- **`<PACKAGE>`** — Package name.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help
